The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. It holds a small pile of cooked bacon, about 6-8 strips that look crisp and are partly broken. Cooked bacon weighs about 8 g per slice, so 7 slices come to roughly 50 g. Crispy bacon is about 5 kcal per gram, which gives roughly 250 kcal for 50 g. The pile looks a little smaller than that, so I'm settling on about 40 g and 200 kcal.
